risky:
You look at Darius, "So how bad are the penalties?"

Darius consults the datapad, "Well, according to them, we have been cited for..."

You interupt, "Just the short version."

Darius nods, "We are ordered to pay a lump sum fine of  ¢983,452 as restitution."

"Ouch," you say as you sit back and in your chair, “We really do not need to get on the wrong side of the Authority.  Ultimately, it will cost less in the long run to just pay the fine.  Darius, accept their terms and pay the fine.”

你看向达利乌斯：“罚款有多严重？”

达利乌斯查看数据板：“根据他们的说法，我们被认定……”

你打断他：“简单说重点。”

“嘶。”你靠回椅子说道，“我们确实没必要和主管当局闹僵。长远来看，直接交罚款反而更省钱。达利乌斯，接受他们的条件并支付罚款。”

Its origin appears natural, but its application is currently unknown. Further study required.\"</color> <color=#BFBFBF>Another line appears moments later.</color> <color=#DFDFDF>\"The mine must be neutralized. It runs deep, too deep to collapse conventionally. However, its above-ground infrastructure includes all atmospheric regulation systems. Remove those, and operations will become untenable. Prepare for immediate deployment.\"</color> <color=#BFBFBF>The transmission ends there. No follow-up, no context. Just orders and a mineral report that raises more questions than it answers.</color> <color=#BFBFBF>After the bridge clears, Farah pulls you aside near the engineering console. She's holding a small sealed sample case.</color> \"Commander, I need to show you something. During the convoy engagement I managed to collect a few fragments from the wreckage before the [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Watch]] recovery teams swept everything. Small pieces, nothing they would have noticed missing.\" <color=#BFBFBF>She opens the case. Inside, three irregular shards of dark metal sit in padded slots. Even under the bay lighting they seem to absorb more light than they reflect.</color> \"I've run preliminary analysis. The alloy doesn't match any known construction or armor standard in our databases. The grain structure is unusual. Density is well above anything used in conventional fabrication, and the stress tolerances I'm measuring suggest a structural application. Something designed to bear enormous sustained load over long periods.\" <color=#BFBFBF>She taps her console, pulling up a comparison chart.</color> \"Whatever this material is intended for, it's being engineered for a scale far beyond standard construction. The tolerances don't make sense for buildings, vehicles, or anything in common use. It's overbuilt for every known application I can think of.\" <color=#BFBFBF>She closes the sample case and looks at you.</color> \"I don't know what it's for, Commander. But someone is mining this material in bulk and shipping it under heavy guard. That's not something you do for a research project. That's production.\"

<color=#DFDFDF>“分析正在进行。对车队残骸的初步扫描发现，货物中有一种身份不明的高密度金属合金，在高温和动能冲击下都极为坚固。它似乎是天然形成的，但用途目前未知。仍需进一步研究。”</color>

<color=#BFBFBF>片刻后，又一行文字出现。</color>

<color=#DFDFDF>“必须摧毁这座矿井。矿道深入地下，深到无法用常规手段炸塌。不过，地面设施包含所有大气调节系统。摧毁这些设施，矿井就无法继续运作。准备立即部署。”</color>

<color=#BFBFBF>通讯到此结束。没有后续，也没有解释，只有命令，以及一份引出更多疑问的矿物报告。</color>

<color=#BFBFBF>桥上人员散去后，Farah在工程控制台附近叫住你。她手里拿着一个密封的小型样本盒。</color>

“指挥官，我得给你看样东西。车队交战期间，我抢在[[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Watch]]回收小组清理现场之前，从残骸里收集了几块碎片。都是小碎片，他们应该不会发现少了东西。”

<color=#BFBFBF>她打开样本盒。里面三个形状不规则的深色金属碎片嵌在衬垫槽中。即使在机库灯光下，它们似乎也只吸收光线，几乎不反光。</color>

“我做了初步分析。这种合金与数据库中任何已知的建筑材料或装甲标准都不匹配。它的晶粒结构很不寻常，密度远超常规制造材料；我测出的应力耐受值则表明，它可能用于承重结构，能在很长时间里持续承担极大的载荷。”

<color=#BFBFBF>她轻点控制台，调出一张对比图。</color>“无论这种材料是做什么用的，它的设计规模都远超标准建筑。现有的建筑、车辆或常见用途都解释不了这些规格。以我能想到的所有已知用途而言，它都强得过头了。”

<color=#BFBFBF>她合上样本盒，望向你。</color>“我不知道它有什么用途，指挥官。但有人正在大量开采这种材料，并派重兵押送。这可不像是在做研究。这是在进行生产。”

risky: Back at the bridge, you tap the console, pulling up the jump sequence, then pause. \"Farah, what are we walking into with Cygnus III?\" Farah looks over and taps her datapad, then slides it your way. \"Terran-class planet, rich biomes. Everything from polar tundra and alpine slopes to badlands, jungles, and lowland forests. Pretty on the surface. Deadly once the weather rolls in.\" She swipes to another screen. \"The atmosphere's unstable. Constant electrical storms, high static charge, interference so strong it bricks half your sensors. Star League used to run weather stations here. Most are ruins now, fried by the storms or torn down by time.\" She shows a strange violet flower blooming from a bed of frost. \"This is the tundra witch. Native to the cold zones. Its pollen's psychoactive. Triggers hallucinations in most species. Draws megafauna like a magnet. Massive grazers that'll stampede over anything that moves.\" She gives a short breath. \"Smugglers still come in, trying to harvest the pollen for narcotics. Most vanish. Either taken by the storms, or trampled into mulch.\" Farah meets your eyes. \"If the Tribe's working here, it's not random. They're hiding something… and they're hoping the planet keeps it hidden.\" [A new flashpoint has been created in the Cygnus system to continue the campaign]

risky: The bridge holotable lights up with a fresh transmission, sealed under full encryption. The identifier reads: Jorgensson, A. The image resolves slowly. Arelle stands at parade rest, her uniform pristine, her posture stiff. She doesn't offer a greeting. \"Commander. Based on recent intelligence intercepts, we have isolated three key sites where the enemy is consolidating assets or infrastructure critical to their next phase of operations. Your unit is to proceed first to Eagle Rest. A hostile relay array has been embedded in legacy terraforming machinery and is suspected of coordinating encrypted off-world logistics. Afterward, you will be directed to Butzfleth Majoris and Cygnus III, in that order. Full details will be provided on arrival. Maintain strict operational silence. Continue to act under Watch directive. That is all.\" The feed cuts before anyone can speak. A beat of silence follows. Darius exhales slowly. \"Well. That wasn't icy at all.\" Yang scratches behind his ear. \"Did she even blink during that?\" Sumire mutters, \"Three jumps. Three systems. Across half a quadrant. In a rustbucket held together by duct tape and Farah's existential dread. Great.\" Farah doesn't look up from her data slate. \"I'll prep the systems. A considerable number of jump sequences, and she's not budgeting any refit time between them. That's going to catch up with us.\" Darius glances at you. \"You want to press forward, Commander? This starts with Eagle Rest. Once we jump... we're committed.\" You nod. The order's clear. The sentiment behind it? Less so. But the war moves on, and you're going with it.
危险选项: 舰桥全息桌亮起，收到一条以最高级别加密的新通讯。识别信息显示：Jorgensson，A。 影像缓缓显现。Arelle立正站着，制服一丝不苟，姿态僵硬，没有寒暄。 “指挥官。 根据近期截获的情报，我们已锁定三个关键地点。敌方正在这些地点集结资产，或建设对下一阶段行动至关重要的基础设施。 你们的部队首先前往 鹰巢。敌方在旧有地貌改造设备中部署了一组敌对通讯中继阵列，怀疑它正协调加密的星际后勤运输。 之后，你们将按顺序前往 布茨弗莱特·麦杰里斯 和 天鹅座III。抵达时会提供完整情报。 严格保持行动静默。继续遵照守望者指令行事。就这样。” 影像在众人开口前便切断了。沉默持续片刻。 Darius缓缓吐气。“嗯，这态度可真够冷淡的。” Yang挠了挠耳后。“她刚才眨眼了吗？” Sumire低声嘟囔：“三次跃迁，三个星系，横跨半个星区。还得靠胶带和Farah的存在主义焦虑把这艘破船粘在一起。好极了。” Farah没有抬头，仍盯着数据板。“我会准备好系统。跃迁次数相当多，而她没给我们安排任何改装时间。迟早会出问题。” Darius看向你。“指挥官，我们继续推进吗？这次行动从鹰巢开始。一旦跃迁……就没有回头路了。” 你点头。命令很明确，背后的用意却未必如此。但战争仍在继续，而你也将继续前行。

risky: Weeks pass aboard the Argo in tense quiet. Contracts roll in, systems get overhauled, the crew drifts back into the routines of downtime, yet no one quite relaxes. The [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Minnesota Tribe]] has gone dark since the last campaign. No broadcasts. No incursions. No retaliation. That changes with the arrival of a sealed transmission, stamped Classified: Watch Cipher Omega-Black. One of the most secure protocols Arelle has provided, requiring a multi-part decryption key with biometric components. The attached [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Ghost Bear Watch]] briefing is meticulous and alarming. The Minnesota Tribe has launched a major coordinated operation, designated Operation Cobra Strike. Without warning, they seized control of several colony worlds far closer to the Inner Sphere than their previous holdings, some within jump distance of major trade corridors. Each strike unfolded with surgical precision: small units, heavy tonnage, zero warning. From these footholds, they initiated a synchronized wave of deep raids across multiple sectors. Munitions depots. Forward command posts. Sensor networks. Even limited strikes within the borders of the Great Houses. The timing of each hit was near-perfect, and the identity of the attackers remained ambiguous long enough to paralyze defenses. According to the Watch, these raids completely bypassed the outer systems the crew had helped retake. Horgens, Star Cluster 752, Rim Worlds Republic Outpost #11. All untouched. The Watch seems to have no explanation for how they slipped past Ghost Bear lines without triggering alarms. False transponder codes. Repainted hulls. Silent jumps. It's clear the Tribe's veil of secrecy has not only held. It's gotten stronger. As Darius scans the report, his jaw tightens. \"This wasn't a reaction. It was well prepared. And we're behind again.\" He glances toward the comms array. \"We better head back to Melidron. I bet we're going to hear from Arelle soon.\"
危险选项: 数周过去，阿尔戈号上始终笼罩着紧张的沉寂。合同陆续到来，系统逐一检修，船员们也渐渐恢复日常休整，但没有人真正放松下来。自上次战役以来，[[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Minnesota Tribe]]销声匿迹：没有广播，没有入侵，也没有报复行动。 一条加盖“机密：守望者欧米伽黑级密钥”印记的加密通讯打破了平静。这是Arelle提供过的最高安全级别协议之一，需要由多个部分组成、包含生物特征信息的解密密钥。 随附的[[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],幽灵熊氏族 Watch]]简报详尽而令人不安。 明尼苏达部族发动了一场大规模协同作战，代号眼镜蛇突击行动。他们毫无预警地夺取了数个殖民世界，这些星球比他们此前占据的据点更接近内环，其中一些甚至处于主要贸易航道的跃迁范围内。每次突袭都精准得如同外科手术：小股部队、重型机甲、毫无预警。 他们以这些据点为跳板，在多个区域同步发动纵深袭击，目标包括弹药库、前沿指挥所、传感器网络，甚至大诸侯国境内的有限目标。每次袭击的时机都近乎完美，攻击者的身份也一直模糊不清，足以让防御方陷入瘫痪。 守望者称，这些袭击完全绕过了船员们协助夺回的外围星系：霍根斯、星团752、边疆世界共和国前哨站#11。这些地方全都毫发无损。守望者似乎也无法解释，部族如何在不触发警报的情况下穿过幽灵熊防线。 伪造的应答信号代码、重新涂装的舰体、静默跃迁。显然，部族的隐匿不仅维持住了，还变得更加严密。 Darius看着报告，紧咬下颚。 “这不是临时反应。他们准备了很久，而我们又落后了。” 他望向通讯阵列。“我们最好返回梅利德隆。我打赌很快就会收到Arelle的消息。”

危险选项: 最后仪式在实弹演习中的表现无可挑剔。圣伯特驾驶机甲时，它仿佛成了自己身体的延伸，把所有靶标都轰成了冒烟的残骸。 你看着最后仪式迈着沉重步伐走向控制碉堡，惊讶于这台重达70吨的机甲竟如此敏捷。机甲停下后舱门弹开，圣伯特爬出来，顺着梯子往下。即使站在远处，你也看得见他脸上的笑容。 你望向Alys Poole，发现她正压抑着冲过去拥抱圣伯特这种不够专业的冲动，最终只是和他握手，脸上带着克制的微笑。 “表现真是精彩，”你对圣伯特说，“重新坐回驾驶舱是什么感觉？” 圣伯特脸上的笑容怎么也收不住：“最后仪式开起来和原来的机甲一样顺手。伯根工业把它组装得真是出色！” 你笑道：“很高兴听你这么说！”你转向Alys，“感谢你协助重建最后仪式。我们该重新出发，挣些C币，让公司维持下去了。” Alys点头微笑：“我才该感谢你，指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}。这个小项目让我和Burt有机会回忆往事。你们离开前，如果有兴趣赚些C币，我们手头正好有份很适合你们的小活儿。” Darius凑近你说道：“指挥官，离开[[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]之前接个本地任务也没什么坏处。当然，决定权在你。”

危险选项: 有人敲响你办公室的门，你抬头看去，发现Darius正等着进来。“进来吧，Darius，坐。” Darius微笑着走进来坐下：“指挥官，我们收到[[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]搜索小队的消息了。情况和我们猜的一样，那座基地里藏着密室和暗道。” “很好，很好。把完整简报告诉我。”你回答。 Darius讲述了突袭后清理瓦砾、救助伤员、搜寻车队藏身地点线索等工作的进展。将近半小时后，他终于结束了汇报：“最后是几根被挪动的钢梁滑脱，撞穿一面受损的墙，露出了另一侧隐藏的维修库。我们进去后没花多久就找到了失踪的车队。幸运的是，躲在里面的匪徒没有抵抗就投降了。我们赶到时，他们正拼命想让[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]的北极熊启动。” 你慢慢吹了声口哨：“天啊，要是他们真把那台机甲启动了，事情可就糟了！” Darius接着说：“看来[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]对机甲做过改装。没有驾驶者操控时，它与其说是战斗机器，不如说是摆设。” 你满脸困惑：“什么？他们的技师没法绕过启动程序，甚至不能切换到维护模式？就算没有武器，一台100吨的突击机甲也足以把手无寸铁的工人砸得粉碎。” Darius摇摇头：“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]在那台北极熊上装了某种生物识别锁。它只能走一小段距离，就会彻底关机；现在正是这种状态。要把它弄回阿尔戈号，我们要么连同一辆战斗机甲回收车一起装上猎豹级飞船，要么派[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]下去亲自取回机甲。

risky: A knock sounds on your office door and you look up to see [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] standing there, \"Come in, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], what's on your mind?\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] comes in and stands before your desk, \"Well Sir, as you know, before I hired on with {COMPANY.CompanyName}, I associated with some, shall we say, less than favourful people.\" You motion for them to take a seat and continue. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] sits and resumes talking, \"Anyways, I was pretty close to one of them and they have contacted me telling me of some information that they found out about {COMPANY.CompanyName} and the Argo and I thought it wise to present it to you.\" You lean back in your chair, \"What is this information then?\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] seems a bit nervous as they continue, \"So my friend says that they found a file in the Commercial Jumpship Transit Authority database which has our company and the Argo flagged.\" Your expression hardens, \"Let me guess, your so-called friend wants money to make that file disappear? Are you trying to shake me down, MechWarrior?\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is shocked, \"Gosh no, Commander! I may have had a coloured past, but I left that life behind me. If I were trying to extort this company, I would not be here telling you this, it would have been delivered via a RANSOMWARE packet or similar means. I assure you, this, as much as it seems suspect, is legit.\" You relax a bit, \"I suspect there is a BUT in that explanation somewhere.\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] nods, \"Unfortunately yes, Commander. Try as I might, my former so-called friends still want to be paid for anything they do to change or remove that file.\" You snort, \"I guess I can't really expect a group of hackers to do anything for free eh? \" You push a button on your desk console, \"Darius, get in here.\" A few moments later Darius enters your office, \"Yes, Commander?\" You motion for Darius to sit down before turning back to [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], \"So, how much do they want, and what precisely can they do for us?\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] responds, \"There are a couple of things they can do, with the varying cost based on how many auditors have been assigned your case: Reset the marker on jump costs back to ¢25,000 per jump. You may still get a followup flag from the CJSTA, but you'll not be spending a ton of extra C-Bills on travel. Expect a fee of up to ¢5,000,000. The other option is a complete wipe of your file and audit trail. This is the most extensive cover-up and as such can cost close to ¢7,500,000. You'll only be contacted by the CJSTA again if you keep traveling the way you have been that got you flagged in the first place. I'll relay your choice to my former associates.\"

risky: A misjump can occur because of miscalculations, technical problems, or spatial anomalies, causing the JumpShip to deviate from its intended destination and emerge off course and often also causing damage to the K-F drive in the process and sometimes to the crew and cargo the JumpShip is carrying. Errors are typically in terms of kilometers or astronomical units, but misjumps of light-years have occurred. Sometimes ships end up in a different star system than the one that they intended to jump to, or stranded in deep space. Misjumps have even been known to move ships far beyond the threshold of 30 light-years in rare instances: The accidental discovery of Alfirk occurred due to a misjump that carried the ship across at least 600 light-years in a single jump; similarly, the wreckage of the Liberator was found over 350 light-years from its last known position.

Darius 出现在指挥甲板上，手里拿着数据板，神情既觉得好笑又有些担忧。

“指挥官，还记得 Bagele 提过的那个神秘补给仓吗？据说是他以前的一位客户藏起来的。那人谁也不信任，在边境地带各处埋下了应急物资。”

你点点头。

“看来要么是 Bagele 想象力特别丰富，要么就是 {TGT_MW.Subj} 确实知道该去哪儿找。”

主屏幕切换成一张传感器图像。一颗小行星正在太空中缓缓旋转，表面用粗重缆线固定着一个大型补给舱。舱体每一寸表面都贴满了褪色的危险品警告标志。

几乎就在同时，Bagele 来到舰桥。{TGT_MW.Subj} 一看到屏幕上的图像，{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:停:Default:停} 在原地，整个人僵住了。“不可能……”

“你认得它？”你问。

“认得这些标记。那些警告标志是他想出来的。他以前总开玩笑说，谁会去偷一个标着‘危险放射性物质’的货柜？大多数人甚至不会靠近到能看清标签的地方。”

Darius 放大图像。“根据传感器读数，这些警告大多是假的。大多而已。确实有辐射痕迹，但在这个距离上没有危险。”

你再次端详屏幕。尽管外观破旧，补给舱看起来依然完好。固定缆线已经磨损，却仍然牢牢连着。

Darius 抱起双臂。“补给舱没有发出信号，我也没检测到任何主动防御系统。但这不代表它一定安全。把物资藏在荒无人烟的地方，通常就是不想让陌生人来翻找。”

舰桥陷入沉默。这个来自 Bagele 过去的神秘补给仓藏在深空中，外面还布满了用来吓退所有人的警告标志。

Darius 终于打破沉默。“所以，指挥官……有个补给舱固定在一颗小行星上，外面贴满危险品警告，我们完全不知道里面装着什么。”他抬头看向你。“要打开它吗？”

risky: The priority transmission indicator flashes on your command console aboard the Argo. Darius glances at the source identifier and immediately closes his eyes. \"Commander. Before I answer this, I want it officially recorded that I know exactly who this is.\" You sigh. \"Put it through.\" The pirate appears on screen. This time he looks exhausted. The camera feed shakes slightly as he adjusts it, revealing the customized Hatchetman behind him. Or rather, what remains assembled of it. Several access panels are missing. One arm hangs suspended from a maintenance gantry. The cockpit canopy sits on a workbench in the background. Various components have been tagged, inventoried, and chained down. Most concerning of all, several pirates can be seen lurking suspiciously close to the BattleMech while attempting to look innocent. \"Commander! Just the person I wanted to see.\" A loud metallic clanging sound echoes from somewhere off camera. The pirate leader immediately turns his head. \"Put that HeatSink back where you found it!\" A muffled voice responds. \"I was cleaning it!\" \"You were carrying it toward your personal shuttle!\" The pirate turns back toward the camera and forces a smile. \"Crew management. The true challenge of leadership.\" At the mention of the BattleMech, Bagele practically materializes beside your command station. His eyes widen in horror. \"What happened to my Hatchetman?!\" \"Preventative maintenance,\" the pirate replies quickly. Another loud crash sounds from off screen. \"THAT POLLY IS NOT A SOUVENIR!\" the pirate roars. Several figures immediately scatter out of view. The pirate rubs his temples. \"Commander, do you have any idea how difficult it is to stop pirates from stealing parts off a BattleMech that technically belongs to somebody else?\" \"Apparently very difficult,\" Darius mutters. \"Extremely difficult.\" The pirate sighs heavily. \"Every day I keep this machine intact costs me money, personnel, and increasingly creative explanations.\" Bagele looks physically distressed. \"It's still all there, right?\" \"Mostly.\" the pirate shrugs. Bagele's face falls. \"Mostly?\" \"Everything important is still there,\" the pirate says quickly. \"Anything missing has been recovered. Probably.\" He points toward the camera. \"Which brings us back to the reason for this call. The current storage and maintenance fee remains three million C-Bills. Against all business sense and repeated recommendations from my associates.\" One of the pirates in the background shouts, \"Can I have the targeting computer if they say no?\" \"NO!\" both the pirate leader and Bagele shout simultaneously. risky: There are some nonstandard jump points that will allow a JumpShip to enter a system inside the proximity limit. As these points are much closer to the habitable planets of a star system, they are prime choices for raiders and pirates, leading to their designation as pirate points. These jump points exist where the gravitational attraction of all planetary objects cancels each other out and overall gravitation is reduced below the critical limit for hyperspace field formation. While pirate point locations can be estimated by secondary school physics (generally, pirate points inside the proximity limit are congruent with the Lagrange Points, which exists due to the cancellation of gravity between two bodies), such jump points are difficult for JumpShips to utilize because they are much smaller than the standard jump points and have much more complicated motions. Rather than only following the star like the zenith and nadir points, the pirate points are subject to gravity of other moving objects in the star system. This makes a navigator's job nightmarish when attempting to use a pirate point. Plotting the jump is impossible without computer aid, and can take hours with one. Missing the jump point is entirely possible, resulting in the JumpShip attempting to arrive in a region of space that is not a valid jump point.
危险选项: 有些非标准跃迁点能让跃迁舰在星系的接近限制范围内进入。由于这些跃迁点离星系内适宜居住的行星更近，因此常被袭击者和海盗利用，也因此被称为海盗跃迁点。这类跃迁点存在于所有行星天体引力相互抵消、整体引力低于形成超空间力场临界值的位置。虽然可以用中学物理知识估算海盗跃迁点的位置（通常，接近限制范围内的海盗跃迁点与拉格朗日点重合，因为两个天体之间的引力会在那里相互抵消），但跃迁舰很难利用这些点，因为它们比标准跃迁点小得多，而且运动轨迹复杂得多。天顶点和天底点只需跟随恒星，而海盗跃迁点还会受到星系中其他运动天体的引力影响。这让导航员使用海盗跃迁点时头疼不已。没有计算机辅助就无法计算跃迁路线，即使有计算机也可能要花上数小时。完全可能错过跃迁点，导致跃迁舰试图抵达一个并非有效跃迁点的太空区域。

risky: Waiting for the Liaison Office to get back to you was worse than waiting for a lance of UM-R60's to finish a 50km patrol circuit. Eventually, the message arrived inviting you and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] down to their facility. The trip down to [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] was routine and uneventful. Sumire is given coordinates to bypass the local starport and head directly to a private landing pad at the Bergan Industires facility. As you exit the Leopard you are greeted by the Bergan Industires Liaison, \"Greetings Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Welcome to Bergan Industires. I am Alys Poole. The trip to the main facility is short, but please, enjoy the ride.\" You shake her hand and follow the others as they board the awaiting [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_BerganAPC],APC]]. Alys and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] board last making it obvious she is more than just a contact. Arriving at the facility, everyone disembarks and Alys escorts the group past numerous guards. You can see multiple crews already working on repairing the damage done during the earlier battle. Alys stops and opens a door to a glass walled room that overlooks one of the facility's production floors. Everyone finds their seats and Alys steps to the head of the table, \"Welcome again to Bergan Industries. We received your request and have humbly asked you here so we could work out the details in person rather than waiting for delayed HPG transmissions, and to be honest, I really wanted to catch up with {SCN_MW.Firstname},um... [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. But that can wait. I was aware that {SCN_MW.Firstname} needed access to our Mech Assembly Bays, but you also wish us to provide you with the base Minsk MNK-102 chassis?\" You nod, \"In a nutshell, yes, that's the gist of it. We've been to six systems collecting the unique parts for this mech and all that's needed to finish is the chassis itself. Your company did ask if there was anything esle you could do to repay our part in liberating this facility. Alys puts her finger up to her ear, obviously listening to someone on the other end. She looks at you for a few moments before speaking, \"Ok Commander, we don't want to look unappreciative for your assistance, but you must understand that Bergan Industries is not fully functional right now. With that in mind, we will provide you with a Minsk MNK-102 chassis, but you will have to provide the labour from your own astech teams. We will also need {SCN_MW.Firstname} onsite during the assembly to properly sync {SCN_MW.Det} biometrics for the mech's neurohelmet and security protocols. Expect around 60 days give or take to complete the rebuild.\" You whistle, \"60 days is a long time to operate with a diminished repair team on the Argo, not to mention losing access to a valued mechwarrior. Surely there is another option on the table?\" Alys scrolls through her datapad, \"Keep in mind we are not billing you for any of this. If we use our existing crews, who will still have to do shifts on the facility repair detail, it could take up to 5 months to finish your project. And {SCN_MW.FirstName} would be well looked after during that time with m... us.\" You look directly at Alys, \"What's the magic number then?\" Alys looks back to you, confused, \"I do not know what you mean, Commander. We cannot...\" You interupt her excuse, \"Don't be coy with me, you run a business, and time is money. How much do you want to expedite the assembly of the mech?\" Alys stares at you for what seems like an eternity, \"The chassis alone is over ¢4,000,000 not including labour and the parts you are not providing... ¢12,000,000 and 2 weeks to rush the work order. And for the record, I didn't originally offer this option because I truly wanted a way for us to provide the necessary tools without costing you any C-Bills. What is you choice?\"

Bagele 神情黯然：“指挥官……”

你摇摇头：“决定已定。”

海盗夸张地叹了口气：“真是一场悲剧。”

“不是悲剧，”你回答，“这是商业决策。”

海盗不情愿地点头：“也有道理。指挥官知道自己的底线，我没理由责怪你。”

Bagele 转开视线，难掩失望。海盗注意到了：“抱歉，朋友。看来你们这次是没法重逢了。”

通讯中断，屏幕暗了下来。指挥甲板上陷入沉默。

Bagele 盯着空白屏幕好一会儿，终于开口：“……明白了，指挥官。”

他说得很职业，可语气里的失望藏不住。

risky: You down the last of your drink, steeling up the nerve to go and speak to a man that has commanded a thousand times over more people than you would ever dream of and head over towards his table. You notice the looks of other patrons towards the Khan sitting alone at his table: Anger, Contempt, Intrigue, Awe… the list goes on and on but no one other than you and the bar staff seem willing to approach. As you arrive at the Khan's table, he smiles, and gestures for you to sit, not even concerned with the reason for you approaching. Before you can say anything, Khan Darkan K'Haos slides a tankard across to you, “You are curious as to why I am here and not with my clan, quiaff?” The clan dialect distracts you for a moment, as does the fact that this man seated, can still look you straight in the eyes without inclining his head when you are still standing. You sit down, now forced to look up to meet his gaze, “Um, well, yes. It does come across as odd that you would be in a bar for mechwarriors looking for employment.” The Khan smiles, “Suffice it to say that I needed a break from my duties as Khan of Clan Ghost Bear. I still yearn for the cockpit of a mech and the roar of battle around me, so I thought to find a company I could loan myself out to that would scratch that itch. This is such a place and you are here to ask me to join your group, quiaff?” You nod, “Yes, I would be interested in having you as a member of my company.” The Khan downs his drink, “Convince me that your company is worthy, Commander…” “Commander {Comander.FirstName} {Commander.LastName}”, you respond. Over the next couple of hours, and many tankards of local ale, you and the Khan discuss the nuances of running a company versus being a Khan of a Clan. Towards the end of the evening, Khan Darkan K'Haos extends his hand to you, “Commander {Comander.FirstName} {Commander.LastName}, your vision appears aligned with my own. I will join you and your company. Bargained well and done!” <color=#f69c24>Hiring fee for Darkan K'Haos has been deducted from your account Darkan K'Haos is now in your barracks</color>
危险选项:
你喝完最后一口酒，鼓起勇气，走向那个曾经指挥过比你做梦都不敢想象的庞大部队的男人。

酒吧里其他客人望着独自坐在桌旁的可汗：愤怒、轻蔑、好奇、敬畏……各种目光交织，但除了你和酒吧工作人员，似乎没人敢上前。

你走到可汗桌旁时，他微笑着示意你坐下，丝毫不在意你为何前来。你还没来得及开口，可汗 Darkan K'Haos 就把一杯酒推到你面前：“你好奇我为什么在这儿，而不是和我的氏族待在一起，对吗？”

氏族方言让你愣了一下，更让你惊讶的是，这个坐着的男人即使不抬头，也能直视仍站着的你。你坐下后只得仰头迎上他的目光：“呃，没错。一个来找工作的机甲战士，出现在雇佣兵酒吧里，确实有点奇怪。”

可汗微笑道：“简单来说，我需要暂时离开幽灵熊氏族可汗的职责。我仍怀念坐进机甲驾驶舱、听着战场轰鸣冲锋的日子，所以想找一家能让我受雇出战的公司，满足这个愿望。这里正合适，而你是来邀请我加入你的队伍，对吗？”

你点点头：“没错，我很愿意让你加入我的公司。”

可汗一口喝完酒：“说服我，你的公司值得我加入，指挥官……”

你回答：“指挥官 {Comander.FirstName} {Commander.LastName}。”

接下来几个小时里，你和可汗喝了许多当地麦酒，讨论经营公司与担任氏族可汗之间的种种差异。夜色渐深时，可汗 Darkan K'Haos 向你伸出手：“指挥官 {Comander.FirstName} {Commander.LastName}，你的愿景似乎与我一致。我愿意加入你和你的公司。谈得漂亮，合作愉快！”

<color=#f69c24>已从你的账户扣除雇用 Darkan K'Haos 的费用

Darkan K'Haos 现已加入你的兵营</color>

risky: You finish your drink, grab the datapad and buy another round for Yang, \"Thanks for your hard work on this Yang. I'll get in touch with the Collector and get that mech sold.\" You arrive back at your office and sit down at your desk. You connect the datapad to your comm terminal and open the call register for the only contact listed. You press the CONNECT button to initiate the call. After a few moments, the spinning CONNECTING message is replaced by a view of a very opulent lounge with floor to ceiling windows looking down on the cityscape of one of the larger metropolitan cites on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. No audio appears to be transmitting, and you can see no one there. \"Hello?\" you ask. You here some movement in the background before the view on the screen rotates to a figure hidden in the shadows. \"Hello, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Thank you for getting back in touch with me.\" You stare at the screen thinking, rich people are weird before snapping out of it, \"Uh, yeah, not a problem Mister...\" The unknown figure you are talking to chuckles, \"No need for my name Commander. I cannot afford any of my rivals to know where I obtain my collectibles from. I'm sure you can understand this. Now, lets just get right to it. As I told your associate, I am willing to buy the stripped down chassis which was originally Last Rites, the custom Minsk of the former Khan of Clan Ghost Bear, [[DEAD_MW,{DEAD_MW.Callsign}]], for the sum of ¢500,000 C-Bills.\" You start to laugh before catching yourself, \"I beg your pardon sir, but the asking price is ¢1,500,000 C-Bills.\" The silence drags for what seems like an eternity before the figure responds, \"¢750,000 C-Bills.\" The [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGBL],Glengarry Black Label]] you had earlier steels your resolve and you hold your ground, \"This is a unique mech chassis. We have other interested parties. ¢1,500,000 C-Bills is our price.\" The figure doesn't hesitate and starts to lean forward, \"Good luck with the other buyers, Commander. Good Bye.\" You quickly shout before they can terminate the call, \"¢1,200,000 C-Bills. I have a Mercenary Company to run.\" The shadowy figure leans back in their seat, \"¢1,000,000 C-Bills and this is my final offer Commander.\" Not wishing to lose out, you agree to the final sum and spend the next few hours signing digital paperwork to finalise the deal. Last Rites chassis has been sold and removed from storage
危险选项: 你喝完酒，拿起数据板，又替 Yang 叫了一轮酒：“Yang，辛苦了。谢谢你。我会联系那位收藏家，把机甲卖掉。” 你回到办公室，在桌前坐下。你把数据板连上通讯终端，打开联系人列表，里面只有一个号码。你按下连接按钮。片刻后，旋转的正在连接提示消失，屏幕显示出一间极尽奢华的休息室，落地窗俯瞰着[[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]一座大都会的景色。似乎没有声音传来，房间里也看不见人。“有人吗？”你问。 你听见背景里传来动静，随后屏幕画面转向一个藏在阴影中的身影。“你好，{COMMANDER.LastName} 指挥官。谢谢你回复我。” 你盯着屏幕，心想：有钱人真奇怪。你回过神来：“呃，没问题，先生……我该怎么称呼你？” 那个身份不明的人轻笑一声：“不用知道我的名字，指挥官。我不能让竞争对手知道我的藏品来源，希望你能理解。我们直入正题吧。正如我告诉你同事的，我愿意用 ¢500,000 C币 收购这具拆空的机体。它原本是Last Rites，由前幽灵熊氏族可汗[[DEAD_MW,{DEAD_MW.Callsign}]]定制的 Minsk。” 你差点笑出声，赶紧忍住：“先生，恕我直言，我们的要价是 ¢1,500,000 C币。” 沉默持续了好一会儿，那个身影才回答：“¢750,000 C币。” 先前喝下的 [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGBL],Glengarry Black Label]] 给了你底气，你坚持道：“这是一具独一无二的机体。我们还有其他买家感兴趣。价格就是 ¢1,500,000 C币。” 那个身影毫不迟疑地向前倾身：“祝你和其他买家交易顺利，指挥官。再见。” 对方还没挂断通讯，你赶紧喊道：“¢1,200,000 C币。我还得经营一家雇佣兵公司。” 阴影中的身影靠回座椅：“¢1,000,000 C币，这是我的最终报价，指挥官。” 你不想错过这笔交易，答应了最终价格，接下来几个小时都在签署电子文件，完成交易。 Last Rites 机体已售出并从仓库移除

risky: You glance through the window pane as you pass by the library onboard the Argo and notice [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] surrounded by a mountain of manuals. Your curiosity peaked, you decide to see what's going on and stroll over to {SCN_MW.Obj}. \"Greetings MechWarrior!\" you state as you approach the cluttered desk. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] looks up from {SCN_MW.Det} work and smiles, \"Well met, Commander. You were looking for me, quiaff?\" You still find it hard to get used to clan language structure, but know enough to respect {SCN_MW.Det} beliefs and respond accordingly, \"Quineg, I was just passing by and noticed you deep in what appears to be a research project. I have to admit, I'm curious to see what has captured your interest, if you care to share?\" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] smiles, \"Aff Commander. As you know, I came to be a part of your crew when you rescued me after I was rendered unconscious in battle. While I appreciate you providing me with one of your company mechs, I feel I can be of more value to you, and to {COMPANY.CompanyName} if I had my original mech, Last Rites.\" You nod, knowing most of this from [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s personnel file, \"Correct me if I am wrong, but wasn't your mech pretty much destroyed when Cloud Cobra attacked Rasalhague?\" You can see the pain in {SCN_MW.Det} eyes at the mention of that famous battle, \"Aff Commander, it was. I should have died then, but it was not yet my time. Now, I have spent my off duty time searching records, schematics and Star Charts to hopefully rebuild Last Rites so I will no longer be [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_Powless],powless]] and I can once again be in command of a proper battlemech.\" You raise an eyebrow at that last comment, \"Interesting, and what do you plan on doing now that you have this information? You're contract with us is still active for quite some time you know.\" \"Aff, Commander,\" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] responds. \"That is why I am doing all the background work before submitting my formal request to you.\" You smile, knowing where this is going, \"Let's just assume you've done all the background work already and skip straight to the request shall we?\" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] smiles, \"Aff, Commander. I formally request permission to obtain the parts to rebuild Last Rites, my 70 ton custom Minsk MNK-102. In return, I pledge, on my honour, to treat {COMPANY.CompanyName} as if it were my own Clan until I die.\" You whistle slowly, \"That, my friend, is quite the request. Tell you what, you get all the info together and we can discuss this again at that time.\" [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] reaches down and picks up a datapad and hands it to you, \"Actually, I have all of that information ready now, Commander. The necessary parts are located on 7 different star systems, with most of those in, or near, Rasalhague space. We can go over the details now, quiaff?\"
危险选项: 你经过 阿尔戈号 上的图书馆时，透过窗户瞥见 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 被成堆的手册包围。你好奇发生了什么，决定过去看看，便朝 {SCN_MW.Obj} 走去。 “你好，机甲战士！”你走到堆满东西的桌边说道。 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 从 {SCN_MW.Det} 工作中抬起头，笑道：“指挥官，幸会。你找我有事，对吧？” 你仍不太习惯氏族的语言结构，但知道应该尊重 {SCN_MW.Det} 信念，便照着回应：“不，我只是路过，看到你似乎在埋头做研究。我得承认，我很好奇是什么吸引了你的注意。方便说说吗？” [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 笑了笑：“是，指挥官。你知道，我是在战斗中昏迷后被你救下，才加入你的船员的。虽然我很感激你给了我一台公司的机甲，但我觉得自己能为你和 {COMPANY.CompanyName} 做出更多贡献，只要我能拿回自己的原装机甲——Last Rites。” 你点点头，这些情况大多已在 [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 的人事档案里看到过：“如果我没记错，你的机甲在云蛇氏族进攻 Rasalhague 时几乎被彻底摧毁了吧？” 提到那场著名战役时，你看得出 {SCN_MW.Det} 眼中的痛苦：“是，指挥官，确实如此。我本该死在那里，但那时还没到我的命数。如今我利用休假时间查阅记录、蓝图和星图，希望能重建 Last Rites。这样我就不再是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_Powless],powless]]，也能再次驾驶一台真正的战斗机甲。” 听到最后这句话，你扬起眉毛：“有意思。既然你已经掌握了这些资料，接下来打算怎么办？你和我们的合同还要持续相当长一段时间呢。” “是，指挥官。”[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 回答，“所以我才先把所有准备工作都做好，再正式向你提出请求。” 你笑了笑，知道话题会转到哪里：“不如就当你已经做完所有准备，直接说请求吧？” [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 笑道：“是，指挥官。我正式请求你允许我取得重建 Last Rites 所需的部件。它是我那台 70 吨的定制 Minsk MNK-102。作为回报，我以荣誉起誓，直到生命尽头都会像对待自己的氏族一样对待 {COMPANY.CompanyName}。” 你缓缓吹了声口哨：“朋友，这请求可不小。这样吧，你把所有资料整理齐全，到时我们再谈。” [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] 俯身拿起一块数据板递给你：“其实我已经把资料都准备好了，指挥官。所需部件分布在 7 个不同的星系，大多位于 Rasalhague 星域内或附近。我们现在就可以仔细看看，对吧？”

Although the KF Console is supposed to be installed on a jumpship, I have a way to install it on the Argo.\" You still look confused, \"Without a Kearny-Fuchida drive, we still need to use jumpships for travel. So I fail to see how this console thingy will benefit us at all.\" Dr Murad taps her datapad and sends images and schematics onto the screen on the wall in your office, \"The basic premise is this, Commander. With an activated KF Console onboard the Argo, we can send data to whichever jumpship we have docked with and substitute their NavCom data with that generated by the Console. This will mean the jumpship will then arrive at a pirate point of the system we are going to.\" You steeple your fingers in front of you, \"You think you can just convice a Jumpship Captain to risk using a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePiratePoint],pirate point]]?' Dr Murad speaks up, \"Actually, the navigator will never even know their coordinates have been replaced. They will most likely assume there was a system malfunction or something. The chances of us being singled out as the cause are slim.\" You shake your head, \"Still sounds a lot like using a virus to deliver data to a computer that does not belong to us. What if we do [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]]? What then?\" Dr Murad clears her throat, \"Well, there is always a risk of a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]] regardless of whether a [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePiratePoint],pirate point]] is used or not. Aside from the absolute worst case scenario, total structural implosion, my research suggests that if we were to misjump from the use of the Console, it would either fling us to an uncharted system, we could sustain damage to the Argo's engines, or a combination of both.\" Sumire looks at you, \"How do you wish to proceed, Commander?\"

As your vision returns post jump, Darius calls out, \"The Captain of the jumpship is furious and is going to file a report with the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment.\" You look out the viewport, seeing a totally different system than the one you expected, \"Where the F...\" Sumire interupts your outburst, \"Commander, it appears we are now in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system, which is over 110 light years away from the closest known civilised system of Marius's Tears! All stations are reporting operational as well, so we do not appear to have suffered any noticable damage from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]]. You look at Sumire and Dr Murad, both of whom wanted the Console installed, \"My head hurts from all of this.\" You turn to Darius, \"Plot a path back to civilisation. I'll be in my office. \"

As your vision returns post jump, Darius calls out, \"The Captain of the jumpship is furious and is going to file a report with the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment.\" You look out the viewport, seeing a totally different system than the one you expected, \"Where the F...\" Sumire interupts your outburst, \"Commander, it appears we are now in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system, which is over 250 light years away from the closest known jump-safe system of Hofn! All stations are reporting operational as well, so we do not appear to have suffered any noticable damage from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]]. You look at Sumire and Dr Murad, both of whom wanted the Console installed, \"My head hurts from all of this.\" You turn to Darius, \"Plot a path back to civilisation. I'll be in my office. \"
危险选项: 你看向 Sumire：“想办法把那该死的控制台关掉！” Sumire迅速拨动了几个开关，控制台的光芒暗下来并关闭了。“指挥官，控制台已设为关闭。跳跃计时器显示，我们马上就要跃迁离开：3... 2... 1...”片刻之后，跳跃船的 KF 引擎 启动，穿越太空跃迁时那种令人作呕的感觉席卷了你的全身。 跃迁结束后，你的视线恢复过来。Darius 喊道：“跳跃船的船长非常愤怒，等他们完成全船诊断和损害评估后，就会向 雇佣兵评审委员会（MRB） 和 商业跳跃飞船运输管理局（CJSTA） 提交报告。” 你望向舷窗，看到的星系与预想的完全不同：“这他妈是哪儿……” Sumire 打断了你的话：“指挥官，我们似乎已经到了 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 星系，距离最近的可安全跃迁的已知星系 Hofn 超过 250 光年！ 所有空间站都报告运行正常，因此我们似乎没有因这次[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],误跃迁]]而受到明显损伤。 你看向 Sumire 和 穆拉德博士，他们当初都主张安装这台控制台。“这一切真让我头疼。” 你转向 Darius：“规划一条返回文明世界的路线。我回办公室了。”

As your vision returns post jump, Darius calls out, \"The Captain of the jumpship is furious and is going to file a report with the Mercenary Review Board and the Commercial JumpShip Travel Authority as soon as they finish their shipwide diagnostics and damage assessment.\" You look out the viewport, seeing a totally different system than the one you expected, \"Where the F...\" Sumire interupts your outburst, \"Commander, it appears we are now in the [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] system, which is over 550 light years away from the closest known jump-safe system of Anklan! All stations are reporting operational as well, so we do not appear to have suffered any noticable damage from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],misjump]]. You look at Sumire and Dr Murad, both of whom wanted the Console installed, \"My head hurts from all of this.\" You turn to Darius, \"Plot a path back to civilisation. I'll be in my office. \"
危险选项: 你看向 Sumire：“想办法把那该死的控制台关掉！” Sumire迅速拨动了几个开关，控制台的光芒暗下来并关闭了。“指挥官，控制台已设为关闭。跳跃计时器显示，我们马上就要跃迁离开：3... 2... 1...”片刻之后，跳跃船的 KF 引擎 启动，穿越太空跃迁时那种令人作呕的感觉席卷了你的全身。 跃迁结束后，你的视线恢复过来。Darius 喊道：“跳跃船的船长非常愤怒，等他们完成全船诊断和损害评估后，就会向 雇佣兵评审委员会（MRB） 和 商业跳跃飞船运输管理局（CJSTA） 提交报告。” 你望向舷窗，看到的星系与预想的完全不同：“这他妈是哪儿……” Sumire 打断了你的话：“指挥官，我们似乎已经到了 [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]] 星系，距离最近的可安全跃迁的已知星系 Anklan 超过 550 光年！ 所有空间站都报告运行正常，因此我们似乎没有因这次[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMisjump],误跃迁]]而受到明显损伤。 你看向 Sumire 和 穆拉德博士，他们当初都主张安装这台控制台。“这一切真让我头疼。” 你转向 Darius：“规划一条返回文明世界的路线。我回办公室了。”

risky: You look at Sumire, \"So how does it work? Does it at least have an off switch?\" Sumire consults her datapad, \"The short version is that the console, when active, will start running calculations based on nearby systems and the system we are currently in. When we enter in a system destination, it uses the data already calculated to try and discern the pirate point, if it exists, of the system we are wishing to travel to. It will send this data without any prompting by us to the JumpShip we are docked with. If all goes well then we jump and arrive a few days sooner than expected.\" You think about it and consider the options, \"Ok. You two begin work on getting the KF Console built and let's see if we get any benefits from it.\" Sumire and Dr Murad smile, \"Right away, Commander!\" You stop them as they are about to leave your office, \"If things go south, or it doesn't help us, I want it deactivated and not used again.\" They respond in unison, \"Understood, Commander!\"

你看向 Sumire：“它是怎么工作的？至少有个关机开关吧？”Sumire 查看着数据板：“简单来说，控制台启动后会根据附近的星系和我们当前所在星系进行计算。输入目的星系后，它会利用已经算出的数据，判断我们要去的星系是否存在海盗补给点。如果有，就会自动把这些数据发送给我们停靠的跳跃舰。顺利的话，我们就能提前几天抵达。”

你想了想，权衡着各种可能：“好吧。你们两个开始建造 KF 控制台，看看它能不能给我们带来些好处。”

Sumire 和 Murad 医生笑了起来：“马上开始，指挥官！”

你在她们离开办公室前叫住她们：“如果情况不妙，或者它帮不上忙，我要你们停用控制台，以后也不许再用。”

两人异口同声地回答：“明白，指挥官！”

risky: You look from the holocom to Bagele and back again. Three million C-Bills is a ridiculous amount for a salvaged Hatchetman. Then again, this isn't just a Hatchetman. You sigh. \"Three million. Not one C-Bill more.\" The pirate's grin immediately widens. \"Commander, I knew you were a visionary.\" Bagele looks like he's about to collapse from relief. \"Really? You're buying it?\" You nod. \"You're lucky I value experienced MechWarriors more than I value my accounting reports.\" The pirate laughs. \"A pleasure doing business with you. I'll have my people prepare the transfer immediately.\" Bagele grabs the holocom and stares at the image of the Hatchetman. \"I never thought I'd see it again.\" The pirate points a finger toward the camera. \"We'll get her loaded up and she'll be delivered before the day ends. No missing parts. No surprises.\" He pauses. \"Well... no surprises that weren't already installed when we found her.\" The transmission ends. Bagele turns to you, visibly overwhelmed. \"Commander... thank you.\" For the first time since meeting him, he looks genuinely happy.
危险选项:
你看看全息通讯器，又看向 Bagele，再看回屏幕。三百万 C币 买一台打捞回来的 Hatchetman，确实贵得离谱。但这可不只是一台普通的 Hatchetman。你叹了口气：“三百万，一分也不能再多。”

海盗立刻笑得更开了：“指挥官，我就知道您有远见。”Bagele 看起来激动得快要站不住了：“真的？你要买下来？”你点头：“比起账本，我更看重经验丰富的机甲战士，你算走运。”海盗笑道：“合作愉快。我马上安排手下办理移交。”

Bagele 抓过全息通讯器，凝视着 Hatchetman 的影像：“我从没想过还能再见到它。”海盗朝镜头指了指：“我们会把它装船，今天结束前就送到。零件一件不少，也不会有意外。”他顿了顿：“当然，我们发现它时就已经装好的那些东西不算。”

通讯结束了。Bagele 仍然激动不已地看着你：“指挥官……谢谢你。”自从认识他以来，这是你第一次看到他发自内心地高兴。

risky: You wander into the lounge for a drink and hopefully some relaxing music. As you look around the crowded room, you easily notice the large form of a Ghost Bear MechWarrior motioning you to come join {TGT_MW.Obj}. You stroll over and sit down across from [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] who effortlessly reaches across the table and politely slaps your shoulder, \"Greetings, Commander {COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}, How are you this evening?\" You stifle the wince on your face from the friendly slap, knowing its sting will leave a mark but not wanting to show any weakness to a man who commanded 1000's of warriors as Khan of Clan Ghost Bear, \"I'm fine, thank you. How are you?\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] pastes a big smile on {TGT_MW.Det} face, \"I am very well, thank you for asking Commander. Have you ever tried [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_GhostBeer],Ghost Beer]]?\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] holds up a massive pitcher of what looks like nothing but soda water. You look at it and shake you head, \"Umm, no, no I have not. It looks like soda water.\" {TGT_MW.Subj_C} grabs an empty tankard and fills it to the top, the clear liquid foaming over the edge the same way a normal beer would. {TGT_MW.Det_C} smile nearly splits {TGT_MW.Det} face as {TGT_MW.Subj} pushes the drink over to you, and hoists {TGT_MW.Det} own full tankard, \"As you say in the Inner Sphere, Cheers!\" You grab the offered tankard and carefully take a sniff. Your eyes instantly water, offering you a valuable insight as to the potentcy of this particular beverage. Not wanting to insult, you raise the tankard and tap it against {TGT_MW.Det}, \"Cheers!\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] downs nearly half the tankard in one mouthful. You try to mimic {TGT_MW.Obj}, but only manage the smallest of sips as the fiery liquid burns down your throat. The coughing spasms wrack your body for what seems like forever before you catch your breath, \"Wha... What the bloody hell is in that?\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] laughs, but not in a mocking way. \"It does take some getting used to. It is distilled from a grain that grows on Arcadia that is as white as driven snow. The closest way to describe it would possibly be pure carbonated vodka. It will warm your belly and put hair on your chest! You want more, quiaff?\" You're still catching your breath and politely respond, \"Uh... Neg. Let me take my time and finish this tankard first.\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] nods, empties {TGT_MW.Det} tankard and refills it, \"I have been wanting to speak to you for awhile, Commander. I have a favour to ask and was hoping you would be willing to assist me.\" You nod your head, \"Go on, tell me what you need and if it's reasonable we can see about accommodating you.\" \"I do not easily trust those who are not Clan Ghost Bear. You, Commander, and your company, have shown similar tenets to those of my Clan: Strength, Family and Patience. It is because of this, I feel I can trust you with what I need help with.\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] says before pausing to take another drink. You carefully sip your drink before speaking, \"Thank you for your comments, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]. Please continue, what is it you need from {COMPANY.CompanyName}?\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] looks at you evenly, \"Commander, I humbly ask you to assist me in collecting my mech from storage.\" A confused look crosses your face, \"Why is your mech in storage? And for that matter, why don't you just ask Yang to get the techs to ready it?\" \"Neg, Commander. MY mech is not onboard the Argo. It is where I left it, back in clan space. I appreciate you giving me one of the {COMPANY.CompanyName} mechs to pilot, but I am now ready to pilot my mech again.\" You sit back in your chair, digesting this information, \"May I ask why you left your mech behind in the first place?\" [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] clears {TGT_MW.Det} throat, \"The various clans have differing views on those who are not clan. To that end, I decided to travel away from my clan and experience the Inner Sphere under a different set of eyes. To have done so whilst also piloting a customised 100 ton Kodiak would have skewed all perceptions of me and those I have met along the way. I have gained perspective, and seen with my own eyes and heart that just because you are not clan, it does not mean you cannot embody the spirit of being clan. I can see that in how you command your crew and company. I wish to continue experiencing the Inner Sphere with you and {COMPANY.CompanyName}. With my mech, I can be a much more valuable asset for you to have at your disposal.\" \"Wow, that is a lot to take in. Which system in particular are we needing to travel to?\" you ask. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] calmly looks you straight in the eyes, \"I cannot divulge that information until you give me your word that you will assist, Commander.\"

risky: You're sitting at your desk going over various reports and inventories when you come across the datafile submitted to the MRBC regarding the death of [[DEAD_MW,{DEAD_MW.Callsign}]]. {DEAD_MW.Subj_C} {DEAD_MW.Gender?NonBinary:were|Default:was} a valued asset to {COMPANY.CompanyName}. You reach over and press a button activating your comms: \"Yang, please report to my office.\" About 10 minutes later, Yang announces himself at your door, \"Boss, you wanted to see me?\" You wave to the vacant chair, \"Come in, come in. I know you are busy down in the mechbay, but what is the status of that Kodiak that belonged to [[DEAD_MW,{DEAD_MW.Callsign}]]?\" Yang thinks for a moment, \"Well Boss, we tried nearly everything we could to get that mech combat ready, but there are too many components requiring a biometric access code that the chassis itself is currently one big doorstop.\" You nod, \"You tried swapping out the cockpit and control systems I suppose?\" Yang huffed, \"If you can think of it, know that my team and I gave it a darn good nudge. Perhaps the only thing we didn't try was employing a cybernetic hacker.\" You look confused, \"A what now?\" Yang laughs, \"Hey, it's just a rumour bantered around the tech circuits. You hear a whisper on one system or a rumour on another, but the gist of it is that somewhere out there are a crew that specialise in removing bio-locks.\" \"Seriously?\" you ask. \"And you think these people can remove the lock on the Kodiak?\" Yang rubs his chin with his mechanical arm before stretching it out and examining it, \"Honestly Boss, I have no idea if it can be done. It sounds possible. I mean, my arm is bio-linked to me but I have no doubts that if I die, someone out there, if possible, will find a way to use it on someone else.\" You lean back in your chair, \"So, we do not have the ability to unlock the Kodiak ourselves, and we do not know who can, other than unsubstantiated rumours. What's your gut tell you?\" Yang thinks for a bit, then responds, \"The way I see it Boss, we can sell the mech to a collector, we can just scrap it or we can do some poking around when we arrive at a system that has a known Black Market presence.\"
危险选项: 你坐在桌前查看各种报告和库存，发现一份提交给 雇佣兵评审与担保委员会（MRBC）、关于 [[DEAD_MW,{DEAD_MW.Callsign}]] 死亡的资料。{DEAD_MW.Subj_C} {DEAD_MW.Gender?NonBinary:曾|Default:曾} 是 {COMPANY.CompanyName} 的宝贵成员。你伸手按下通讯按钮：“Yang，请到我办公室来一趟。” 大约 10 分钟后，Yang 在门口通报：“老板，你找我？” 你指了指空椅子：“进来，坐。知道你在机甲舱很忙，不过 [[DEAD_MW,{DEAD_MW.Callsign}]] 留下的那台 Kodiak 现在是什么情况？” Yang 想了一会儿：“老板，我们几乎试过所有办法，想让这台。但太多部件都需要生物识别密码，现在整个机体就是个大门挡。” 你点点头：“我猜你们试过更换驾驶舱和控制系统？” Yang 哼了一声：“你能想到的办法，我和团队都认真试过了。也许唯一没试的就是找个电子义体骇客。” 你一脸困惑：“什么？” Yang 笑道：“这只是技术圈里流传的传闻。你会听到这个星系有人低声说起，另一个星系又有人传闲话，大意是外面有支专门破解生物锁的队伍。” “真的？”你问，“你觉得他们能解开 Kodiak 的锁？” Yang 用机械手臂摸了摸下巴，随后伸开手臂打量起来：“说实话，老板，我不知道能不能做到。听起来倒是有可能。我的手臂和我的生物特征绑定，但我毫不怀疑，如果我死了，外面总有人会想办法把它用到别人身上。” 你靠回椅子：“所以我们自己没法解开 Kodiak 的锁，除了未经证实的传闻，也不知道谁能做到。你直觉上觉得该怎么办？” Yang 想了一会儿才回答：“老板，我看可以把这台、直接拆解报废，或者等到了有已知 黑市 的星系再打听打听。”
